name: SoundCloud Presence
description: Show the SoundCloud track you are listening to on your Discord profile, with artwork, a progress bar and a button. It follows your Last.fm now playing automatically (with a scrobbler such as Pano Scrobbler), or takes a pasted link, and can hand the track to your Rich Presence plugin.
author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
